pages.text: $(italic)Lucky, efficient, and oddly hard to hit. Halflings thrive in exploration and resource-gathering builds.$()$(br2)$(bold)Fortune's Favor$() — +8% luck stat. Affects loot table rolls, fishing, and Fortune enchant effectiveness.$(br2)$(bold)Food Efficiency$() — -20% food drain rate. The best food economy in the pack.

pages.title: Traits (cont.)
pages.text: $(bold)Small$() — -15% hitbox size bonus (harder to hit with projectiles). No movement penalty unlike vanilla.$(br2)$(bold)Halfling Luck$() — Once per death: 10% chance to survive a killing blow at 1 HP. Cooldown: 20 min.$(br2)$(bold)Next: pair with Wanderer or Artificer and go loot — luck compounds on every chest.$()
